submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 with a 30 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 91.973% among all tested configurations. This represents a 17.6% improvement over Algorithm-L2 and a 6.3% improvement over Algorithm-L3 at the same threshold. The 30 GeV threshold optimizes the efficiency within the allowed range, as efficiencies decline at both lower (20 GeV: 87.5%) and higher thresholds (40 GeV: 89.9%, 50 GeV: 87.0%, 60 GeV: 77.0%). All hardware and operational constraints are satisfied, making this the optimal choice for maximizing signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
